# Next.js

> > The React Framework for the Web – used by some of the world's largest companies

Next.js is a full-stack React framework developed by Vercel that enables server-side rendering, static site generation, and modern web application development with TypeScript support. The framework features two routing paradigms: the modern App Router with React Server Components and the legacy Pages Router.

## Key Topics

- App Router
- Pages Router
- React Server Components
- TypeScript
- Server-side rendering (SSR)
- Static site generation (SSG)
- Image optimization (next/image)
- Font optimization (next/font)
- Script optimization (next/script)
- CSS Modules
- Self-hosting and deployment
- Turbopack
- Edge Runtime
- Authentication and security
- MDX support

## Getting Started

- [App Router: Getting Started](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started): Getting started with App Router: React Server Components and TypeScript
- [Pages Router: Getting Started](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/getting-started): Getting started guide for Pages Router with create-next-app and TypeScript
- [Getting Started: Project Structure](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/project-structure): Folder and file conventions for App Router and Pages Router projects
- [Getting Started: Linking and Navigating](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/linking-and-navigating): Navigation with Link component: prefetching, client-side transitions, streaming
- [Getting Started: Upgrading](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/upgrading): Upgrade Next.js and React to latest or canary versions with npm/pnpm

## Optimization and Performance

- [Getting Started: Images](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/getting-started/images): Optimize images with next/image: WebP, lazy loading, layout shift prevention
- [Getting Started: Fonts](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/getting-started/fonts): Font optimization with next/font: Google Fonts, self-hosting (Pages Router)
- [Guides: Scripts](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/scripts): Optimize third-party scripts with next/script component (Pages Router)

## Deployment and Configuration

- [Guides: Self-Hosting](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/self-hosting): Self-host Next.js on Node.js, Docker, or static exports with nginx
- [Guides: Authentication](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/authentication): Authentication guide: session management, authorization, securing routes
- [Guides: Sass](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/sass): Style Next.js apps with Sass/SCSS and CSS Modules configuration
- [Guides: MDX](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/mdx): Configure and use MDX (Markdown + JSX) in Next.js App Router applications
- [Guides: JSON-LD](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/json-ld): Add JSON-LD structured data with schema.org for SEO and search engines

## Release Announcements

- [Next.js Security Update: December 11, 2025](https://nextjs.org/blog/security-update-2025-12-11): Security update for React Server Components vulnerabilities (CVE advisory)
- [Next.js 15.3](https://nextjs.org/blog/next-15-3): Next.js 15.3 release: Turbopack builds, navigation hooks, instrumentation
- [Next.js 10.1](https://nextjs.org/blog/next-10-1): Next.js 10.1 release: 3x faster refresh, 58% smaller install, WebAssembly

## API Reference

- [App Router: API Reference](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference): Complete API reference for Next.js App Router, Edge Runtime, Turbopack

## Migration and Error Reference

- [Dynamic APIs are Asynchronous](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/sync-dynamic-apis): Migration guide: dynamic APIs now async in Next.js 15 (params, cookies)
- [No Before Interactive Script Outside Document](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/no-before-interactive-script-outside-document): Error reference: beforeInteractive script must be in _document layout
- [No CSS Tags](https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/no-css-tags): Error reference: use CSS Modules or imports instead of <link> tags
